facts.business: Nilkanth Engineering Limited is an Indian listed company.
key_risks: Financial Risk: instability and losses in the financial market caused by movements in stock prices, currencies, interest rates
Liquidity Risk: unable to meet financial commitments to Bank/Financial Institution; lack of marketability of investment
Credit Risk: loss of principal or financial reward stemming from borrower's failure to repay loan or meet contractual obligation
Time Risk: non-receipt of expected inflow of funds
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review, the Company had not entered into any transactions as enumerated in section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 and rules made thereunder with the related party as defined under section 2(76) of the Act.
